newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta's foothills face slight frost risk on Wed.
newsitem.headline: Alberta's foothills face slight frost risk on Wed.

text.p: A slight risk of frost was forecast for Alberta's foothills Wednesday morning, Environment Canada said.
All of Alberta, including the foothills was forecast to see a slight to moderate frost Thursday and Friday mornings, said Environment Canada in its 10-day frost outlook.
A moderate risk was forecast for Alberta and Saskatchewan northern grainbelts Saturday and Sunday mornings with a slight risk for southern Alberta and Saskatchewan's grainbelt.
A high risk of frost was forecast for Alberta's foothills Sept 23 to 26.
A slight to moderate risk was forecast for the rest of the Prairies Sept 23 to 26.
